desc: Discover the tasty way to fiber with Fiber One Honey Clusters Cereal, made with a touch of real honey. Delicious flakes with honey clusters and toasted oats deliver the flavors you love with the benefit of fiber! Each serving of these delicious, lightly sweetened flakes with honey clusters contains 36% daily value of fiber. Every serving also brings 31g of whole grain to every bowl (at least 48g recommended daily). Serve this fiber cereal made with whole grain with milk as part of a quick and easy breakfast that helps you meet your daily fiber needs. Sprinkle some in yogurt or smoothies to add an irresistible honey cereal crunch. Toss some in snack mix recipes for fiber snacks that help you shine from the inside out. Whether you reach for Fiber One Honey Clusters Cereal as a delicious breakfast addition made with whole grain, or an ingredient in snacks recipes, General Mills breakfast cereals spread goodness from tots to grown-ups. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy Fiber One Honey Clusters Breakfast Cereal, Fiber Cereal Made with Whole Grain, 17.5 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
features:
FIBER CEREAL: Delivers 36% daily value of fiber - Diets high in fiber can help keep your digestive system on track; An ideal ready to eat pantry staple that the whole family can enjoy

MADE WITH REAL HONEY: Delicious, lightly sweetened flakes with honey clusters, made with a touch of real honey; Serve a bowl of cereal with milk or add some to cereal bars recipes as delicious snacks for adults or kids

WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: Each serving of this breakfast cereal provides 31g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), plus vitamins and minerals

FIBER BREAKFAST OR SNACK: Enjoy as a morning cold cereal, or add the honey cereal crunch to homemade trail mix or yogurt

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Fiber One Honey Clusters Breakfast Cereal, Fiber Cereal Made with Whole Grain, 17.5 oz; perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Bran, Sugar, Whole Grain Oats, Rice Flour, Wheat Bran, Corn Syrup, Honey, Salt, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Corn Starch, Barley Malt Extract, Maltodextrin, Molasses, Tripotassium Phosphate, Brown Sugar Syrup, Natural Flavor, Baking Soda, Sucralose, Rosemary Extract, Vitamin E (Mixed Tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness, Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (Mineral Nutrients), Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbate), A B Vitamin (Niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine Hydrochloride), Vitamin B, (Thiamin Mononitrate), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), A B Vitamin (Folic Acid), Vitamin B12.
